title: Mouana Serenity Cherng Talay
shortDescription: Single-storey private pool villas by Mouana Phuket in Thep Krasattri, Cherng Talay: 20 villas of 3 and 4 bedrooms on generous plots.
description:
Mouana Serenity Cherng Talay is a development of single-storey private pool villas by Mouana Phuket in Thep Krasattri, in the Cherng Talay area of Thalang. Project listings count 20 villas on a site of about 12,700 m², in modern tropical architecture with landscaped gardens.
The villas have three or four bedrooms, with about 360 to 413 m² of built-up area on plots of roughly 490 to 680 m². Parking is covered, and agent listings quote a starting price from about THB 26.7 million. Foreign buyers are offered the villas on a leasehold basis, with a reservation fee of THB 200,000, a 30% deposit at contract signing and the remaining 70% in instalments tied to construction progress.
Listings place the project about 8 minutes from Cherng Talay Beach and about 7 minutes from Boat Avenue. Sources disagree on the unit count (16 or 20) and on whether the villas were completed in January 2025 or are due in 2026, so please ask us to confirm the current status and availability.
